name: Iterative Gaussian Synopsis
definition: A top-down strategy to construct a hierarchy of Level of Detail (LOD) representations for 3D Gaussian Splatting. It begins with a full-fidelity model (LOD Lmax-1) and progressively derives coarser levels (LOD Lmax-2 ... LOD 0) through adaptive, learnable pruning of anchors and downsampling of hierarchical grids, ensuring coherent simplification without error accumulation from bottom-up training.
